newsitem.title: USA: Tribune Co Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Tribune Co Q4 net rises.

text.p: Shr primary $0.63 $0.53
Shr diluted $0.57 $0.49
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q4 1995 net results include income from discontinued operations of $7,315,000 or $0.06 a share primary and $0.05 a share fully diluted.
Q4 1995 income from continuing operations $0.47 a share primary and $0.44 a share fully diluted.

Q4 1996 net income includes pre-tax gain of $10 million or $0.05 a share primary, representing Tribune's equity interest in a gain recorded by Qwest Broadcasting for the cancellation of an option to purchase a television station. Excluding item, Q4 1996 net income was $0.58 a share primary and $0.53 a share fully diluted.
Q4 1996 broadcasting, entertainment operating profit $54 million, excluding $10.0 million gain, vs $44 million in Q4 1995.
Q4 1996 publishing operating profit $84.2 million vs $72.2 million. Q4 1996 education operating profit $1.6 million vs loss $2.1 million.
Q4 1996 net income before $4.7 million in preferred dividends vs $5.0 million in Q4 1995.

Q4 1995 results include pretax gain of $7.0 million or $0.03 a primary share. Excluding gain, Q4 1995 net income from continuing operations was $0.44 a primary share and $0.41 fully diluted. Gain was from sale of Compton's NewMedia to Learning Co Inc for $123.0 million of Learning Co shares and $150 million investment in Learning Co notes.
YEAR
Shr primary $2.88 $2.00
Shr diluted $2.62 $1.84
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Full-year 1996 results include income from discontinued operations of $89,317,000 or $0.73 a share primary and $0.65 a share fully diluted. 1996 income from continuing operations $2.15 a share primary and $1.97 diluted.

Full-year 1995 results include income from discontinued operations of $32,707,000 or $0.25 a share primary and $0.23 a share fully diluted. 1995 income from continuing operations $1.75 a share primary and $1.61 diluted.
1996 net income before $18.8 million in preferred dividends vs $18.8 million in 1995.
1996 results include $10.0 million pretax Qwest gain. Excluding gain, 1996 income from continuing operations would be $2.10 a share primary and $1.93 diluted.

Full year 1995 results includes sale of America Online Inc stock, resulting in pretax gain of $15.0 million or $0.07 a primary share; sale of Times Advocate newspaper susbidiary, resulting in pretax loss of $8.0 million or $0.03 a primary share, and Compton's NewMedia/Learning Co transaction, which resulted in pretax gain of $7.0 million or $0.03 a primary share. Excluding items, 1995 income from continuing operations $1.68 primary and $1.55 diluted.
